Madhubani ASI Firing Case: Biahr ke madhubni jile men ek puliskarmi ki kartut samne aaee. jisne pulis mahakme ko savalon ke ghere men la diya. Babubarhi thana kshetr ke Balirajgarh pulis piket men tainat ASI Chandramohan Singh par apni Service revolver se tabartor firing karne ka aarop hai. ghatna men vijay yadav nam ke ek vyakti ki maut ho gaee. jabki tin any log ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gae
